Container.Name: Roamlight
Container.Overview:
Your family's photo album, on your own server, for your own people.
Point Roamlight at the share where your photographs already live. It makes a web copy of each one, reads the date, the camera and the place out of the file, sorts everything into albums and puts the albums on a map. You decide, album by album, who in the family may see it, and nothing leaves the house unless you hand somebody a share link with a password and an end date.
It understands JPEG, HEIC, RAW (CR3, ARW, NEF, DNG and more) and phone videos, never writes into your originals, and plays albums as a slideshow. Sign in with passwords or with your own single sign-on (Authentik, Keycloak and other OpenID Connect providers). There is a free iPhone app on the App Store, and an Android app that your own Roamlight hands out.
Install it, open the web page and create the administrator account. To connect a phone, open "Phone & tablet" on the site.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: photos photo gallery album family pictures heic raw map journey slideshow self-hosted iphone android
Container.Requires: A share that holds (or will hold) your photographs. Roamlight writes new uploads into it, so it has to be writable by the user set in PUID/PGID (99/100, "nobody:users", is right for a normal Unraid share). Create the administrator account right after the first start: until you do, anybody who can reach the page could create it (or set a Setup token below).
Container.DonateText: Roamlight is free. If it brings you joy, a coffee is a lovely way to say so.

Config.Name: Photos
Config.Description: Your photographs, as they came off the camera. Read, and never changed; new uploads are added here.

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: The web copies Roamlight makes: one JPEG per photograph, in the same folders. They can be rebuilt from the photographs, but that takes a while.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: The database (albums, who sees what, accounts) and the smaller web sizes. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Site address
Config.Description: The address people type to reach Roamlight: http://your-server-ip:8080 at home, or https://photos.example.com behind a reverse proxy. Share links and the phone apps use it.

Config.Name: Site title
Config.Description: The name at the top of every page and on the home screen.

Config.Name: Setup token
Config.Description: Optional. A word of your own: the first-start page then only opens with ?t=that-word. Recommended if other people are on your network. Can be removed once the administrator account exists.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: The user the files are written as. 99 is Unraid's 'nobody'.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: The group the files are written as. 100 is Unraid's 'users'.

Config.Name: Sign-in
Config.Description: local (passwords), oidc (your own single sign-on) or local+oidc (both). Single sign-on can also be set up later on the Settings page.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: If a reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik...) is in front: its IP address, so the sign-in throttle can tell visitors apart.

Config.Name: Home
Config.Description: Where your journeys start when an album has no departure of its own (the name shown on the map).

Config.Name: Home latitude
Config.Description: Latitude of your home, for the journey map.

Config.Name: Home longitude
Config.Description: Longitude of your home, for the journey map.

Config.Name: Conversions at once
Config.Description: How many photographs are converted at the same time. Each takes about three quarters of a CPU core.
